meta.name: codex-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Codex Light edition (lazycodex / packages/omo-codex) itself, in strict isolation so ONLY our plugin is exercised, never the user's real ~/.codex. The first-party method drives the real `codex app-server` against an isolated CODEX_HOME plus a LOCAL mock model (no real API call), and proves a plugin hook fired by asserting hook/started + hook/completed notifications. Also: isolated install verification, per-component hook probes, a tmux TUI smoke, and runtime log observation (RUST_LOG / logs SQLite / /debug-config). Ships tested helper scripts each with a --self-test. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-codex or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Codex plugin, its hooks/components, the installer/config.toml, the app-server flow, or the Codex TUI. Triggers: codex qa, qa codex, codex-qa, test codex plugin, verify codex hook, codex app-server, lazycodex qa, isolated CODEX_HOME, prove codex hook fired, codex tui test.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用隔离环境对 omo Codex Light 版插件进行质量检测，包括验证插件钩子是否触发、安装是否正确、组件钩子是否工作、TUI 界面是否正常，以及检查运行时日志。所有操作都不会影响你真实的 ~/.codex 配置。
howto.when: 当你修改了 packages/omo-codex 下的代码，或者需要测试、验证、调试 Codex 插件、钩子、安装、app-server 流程或 TUI 时触发。

say.text: 执行 codex-qa 的安装验证测试。
对 codex-qa 的 TUI 进行冒烟测试。
say.note: 在隔离环境中启动 TUI，检查是否能正常渲染和存活。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will QA the omo Codex Light edition plugin in an isolated environment, including verifying plugin hooks fire, correct installation, component hook behavior, TUI smoke test, and runtime log observation. The real ~/.codex is never touched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you change anything under packages/omo-codex, or need to test, verify, or debug the Codex plugin, hooks, installer, app-server flow, or TUI.

say_en.text: Run the app-server drive test of codex-qa to verify plugin hooks fire.
Execute the install verification test of codex-qa.
Smoke test the TUI of codex-qa.
say_en.note: Boots the TUI in an isolated home and checks it renders and survives.
